claims.claim_text: Nelson P Poynter's best-supported last civilian employer before his wartime government assignment was the St. Petersburg Times, where he was editor.
claims.evidence_excerpt: His first job at the paper in 1938 was general manager. In 1939 he became editor
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Institutional biographies place Poynter at the Times immediately before his dated December 1940 call to Washington.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identity based on distinctive exact name and explicit wartime government and Donovan chronology.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded last civilian employment; the subsequent government assignment is modeled separately.
claims.match_notes: The Times is not mislabeled as the immediate pre-OSS affiliation because a government role intervened.

claims.claim_text: Immediately before William Donovan selected him for Coordinator of Information work, Nelson P Poynter served in the federal inter-American communications press section.
claims.evidence_excerpt: The men most concerned with this Section were Karl A. Bickel ... and Nelson Poynter
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A dated institutional chronology and the official agency history place Poynter in the federal press section before his summer 1941 selection by Donovan.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence distinctive-name match corroborated by official 1941 memoranda and institutional biography.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicit immediate government assignment before work under Donovan; not a civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: The public profile labels the relationship as a government assignment, not employment by a private company.

claims.claim_text: A scholarly archival study supports a high-confidence identity match for indexed Branko Prastalo as Branko Praštalo in the OSS Bari Yugoslav Section.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The rare name, diacritic spelling, OSS context, Yugoslav Section, Bari location, and January 1944 date align with the indexed person.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence rare-name and specific OSS-unit match; the diacritic form is retained as a documented variant.
claims.temporal_assessment: Wartime identity evidence only; it does not identify a pre-OSS employer or prove how he entered OSS.
claims.match_notes: Surrounding discussion of recruitment does not establish Praštalo's individual pre-OSS status and is not converted into an affiliation claim.
